appDescription: Chageun offers conversational novice driving lessons, departure preparation checks, weather-based driving advice, and virtual parking practice while parked.

function.name: TALK_WITH_DRIVING_COACH
function.description: Discuss novice driving questions and follow-up explanations in a coaching conversation, or retrieve the departure preparation checklist. Returns grounded lesson content and available consented vehicle observations.

operation.description: Whether to start coaching, ask a question, repeat guidance, end coaching, or check the departure checklist; ASK is the default.

question.description: The driver's current question or follow-up in the original language, up to 600 characters.

topic.description: The driving subject; CURRENT retains the ongoing lesson for a follow-up, while OTHER indicates a subject outside the supported lessons.

focus.description: The requested kind of explanation, including a short overview, reasons, ordered preparation steps, or cautions.

function.name: GET_WEATHER_DRIVING_ADVICE
function.description: Retrieve current weather-based driving advice using the consented location or the explicitly identified default area when location is unavailable.

function.name: START_PARKING_PRACTICE
function.description: Start virtual parking practice while the vehicle is parked and the preparation checklist is complete, or open the required preparation steps.

course.description: The requested virtual parking course; reverse bay parking is used when omitted.
